integrity: Proof derives a pair of cavity equations from conditional exponential clocks and solves a modified Bessel equation; independent finite-path exact arrival-order enumeration and ODE comparisons are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Exact period-two independent Poisson dimer deposition on the infinite chain; no result for random disorder, trimers, occupancy variance, or monotonicity in rate contrast. Full bibliographic priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact Bessel jamming law for alternating-rate dimers on the integer chain
